defect_observations.note: Read-only host says the cited construction combines compactness with finite Ramsey arguments, and later (about line 276) that finite Ramsey theory and compactness supply the coherent blueprint; the new chapter (body 208-232) shows the written proofs use the infinite Theorem A, with the finite Theorem B only as an alternative. The host phrasing is now inconsistent with the chapter.

def:p03-morley-skolem-hull speaks of a countable Skolem expansion, but the new lemmas thm:p03-w03-p03-028-coherent, -realize and -elementary (body 267-327) take T^sk from that definition for arbitrary T, and the host thm:p03-em-models is for every first-order T. The language-cardinality assumption of the blueprint lemmas is left implicit; annex 342-347 handles arbitrary cardinality only for Theorem 5.7.

The corollary that axiom systems of arithmetic have models with non-trivial automorphisms is reported without a derivation from Theorem 5.6; the article itself states it only in its introduction (p.50).
